"""Exact complete original-header book publication, unchanged capacity and native rendered guidance."""
import argparse
import json
import subprocess
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, REVISION, need, pin, save

CHAPTER = Path('docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md')
REGISTRY = Path('doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl')
ANCHOR = 'The complete finite raw-address and numerical/source parent acceptance is now\nqualified.'
TRANSFORMS = {'This closes the unchanged source-header parent only. Original raw-header joining\nis next under its separate owner; observer/raw/native/private and visual\nacceptance retain their scopes.\n': 'The source-header qualification closes its own parent. The original raw-header\njoin is described below; full observer publication and higher raw/native/private\nand visual acceptance retain their separate owners.\n'}
ADDITION = 'Complete original own encoded headers now join their qualified source expressions.\nEvery core, operation wrapper, named helper, callback, subtest body, delegate and\nentry view retains its complete source role and original frame allocation.\nOverlapping views remain explicit aliases of the same captured frame. The public\nsubtest expression retains the full authored name and callback kind with its\nwhole opaque receiver interval.\n\nKnown argument values use the previously qualified explicit public grammar.\nWhole quotes, escapes, truncation suffixes, argument separators, hidden arguments\nand the remaining-argument marker qualify together. Full authored regex values\nretain all qualified constructor alternatives. Encoded compatibility does not\nmeasure the original formatter settings, flags, encoding or provider identity.\n\nEvery reference token and remaining private/framework interval retains its whole\noriginal bytes. Source-declared display classes and reference kinds qualify the\nvisible spelling; native class, referent contents and identity remain unmeasured.\nThe source do operator and diagnostic require marker keep their distinct roles.\nThe complete original raw, address, coordinate and source domains conserve.\n\nAn actual different proper subtest-name prefix still passes the deliberately\nlimited predecessor predicate and now fails the complete known-token contract.\nBorrowed, omitted, reordered, wrong-role, quote, truncation, count, whole-token,\nsource-profile and scope controls reject their intended contracts. Independent\nlexing and source rendering reconstruct every complete result. All complete\nprerequisites reexecute in their qualified current or dated contexts:\n\n```sh\nscripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh -- python3 -B docs/audits/observer-original-header-join-20261011/verify.py\n```\n\nThis closes only the unchanged header-repair acceptance. Complete observer\npublication and parent acceptance are next under their separate owner; higher\nraw, consumer, alias, cold, native/private and visual scopes remain open.\n\n'


def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git','--no-replace-objects',*args],capture_output=True)
    need(result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr,'whole fixed book authority')
    return result.stdout


def aggregate(rows):
    return dict(files=len(rows),lines_total=sum(r.count(b'\n') for r in rows),bytes_total=sum(map(len,rows)))


def source():
    names = sorted(name for name in git('ls-tree','-r','--name-only',REVISION,'--','docs/book/src').decode().splitlines()
                   if Path(name).parent == Path('docs/book/src') and name.endswith('.md'))
    before = {name:git('show',REVISION+':'+name) for name in names}
    need(before[str(CHAPTER)].decode().count(ANCHOR)==1 and ADDITION not in before[str(CHAPTER)].decode(), 'unique original-header guide source seam')
    after=dict(before)
    changed=before[str(CHAPTER)].decode()
    for old,new in TRANSFORMS.items():
        need(changed.count(old)==1,'unique owned prior source-status wording')
        changed=changed.replace(old,new,1)
    after[str(CHAPTER)]=changed.replace(ANCHOR,ADDITION+ANCHOR,1).encode()
    return before,after


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--publish',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--native',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--native-output',default='book-native.json',choices=['book-native.json','book-native-final.json'])
    args=parser.parse_args()
    before,after=source()
    current={str(p):p.read_bytes() for p in Path('docs/book/src').glob('*.md')}
    if args.publish:
        need(current==before, 'publish only the owned sole original-header book addition')
        CHAPTER.write_bytes(after[str(CHAPTER)])
        rows=[json.loads(line) for line in REGISTRY.read_bytes().splitlines()]
        authority=next(r for r in rows if r.get('surface_id')=='shipped_behavior')['reference_contract']
        a,b=aggregate(list(before.values())),aggregate(list(after.values()))
        authority['aggregate_change']=dict(authority_id='OBSERVER-ORIGINAL-HEADER-JOIN-20261011',
            owner=(BASE/'scope.txt').read_text().splitlines()[0],baseline=a,
            delta={key:b[key]-a[key] for key in a},
            rationale='Document complete original encoded header/source joins, full formatting controls and conserved opaque intervals while retaining every original unknown and separately owned observer/raw/native/private boundary.')
        REGISTRY.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True)+'\n' for r in rows))
        save('book-publication.json',dict(revision=REVISION,addition=ADDITION,
            before={k:pin(v) for k,v in before.items()}, after={k:pin(v) for k,v in after.items()},
            authority=authority['aggregate_change']))
        print('PASS exact sole original-header book addition and fresh aggregate authority; capacity ceilings unchanged.')
    else:
        need(current==after, 'entire current original-header book publication and complete unchanged peers')
        if args.native:
            class Text(HTMLParser):
                def __init__(self):
                    super().__init__();self.parts=[]
                def handle_data(self,data):
                    self.parts.append(data)
            raw=Path('docs/book/book/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.html').read_bytes()
            reader=Text();reader.feed(raw.decode())
            rendered=ADDITION
            expected=' '.join(line for line in rendered.splitlines() if not line.startswith('```'))
            need(' '.join(''.join(reader.parts).split()).count(' '.join(expected.split()))==1,
                 'whole unique rendered original-header guide')
            save(args.native_output,dict(chapter=pin(raw),addition=pin(ADDITION.encode()),
                scope='Whole native guidance text and source custody only; visual book QA remains open.'))
        print('PASS complete current original-header guide and source publication; visual QA remains separately owned.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Complete external gate receipts; expected diagnostics remain visible."""
import json
import fcntl
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv)>=3, 'named check and explicit command')
    name,command=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2:]
    path=BASE/'checks.json'
    lock_path=Path('.artifacts/observer-original-header-join-20261011/checks.lock')
    lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
    inputs={str(p):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(BASE.glob('*.py'))}
    inputs.update({arg:pin(Path(arg).read_bytes()) for arg in command if Path(arg).is_file()})
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
    # Commands may run independently; only this short read/merge/write is
    # serialized. Reload after the child so an older invocation cannot erase
    # a receipt completed while it was running.
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
        saved[name]=dict(command=command,status=result.returncode,stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr,inputs=inputs)
        path.write_bytes(canonical(saved))
    print(name,result.returncode,result.stdout[-1400:],result.stderr[-1800:],flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode==0,'external check success: '+name)

"""Actual complete raw/header interventions and declared predecessor distinctions."""
import copy
import gzip
from common import BASE, CLASS, HEADERS, SCOPE, canonical, load, need, pin, read, same, save
import join_headers
import oracle


def module(path):
    namespace = {'__name__':'original_header_control_dependency','__file__':str(path)}
    exec(compile(path.read_bytes(),str(path),'exec'),namespace)
    return namespace


def controls(write=False):
    original = read(CLASS/'raw-product.json')['inventories']
    product = read(HEADERS/'headers.json')
    selection = load('selected.json')
    joined = load('joined.json')
    old = module(CLASS/'verify.py')
    trace = old['public']['context']['module'](old['public']['context']['RAW']/'trace_inventory.py')['inventory']
    expected = read(CLASS/'source-models.json')
    nested = old['public']['context']['nested_records'](expected['frame_model']['own'])
    results=[]
    def record(native, allocation):
        mode,domain,index=allocation['record']
        return next(r for m in native if m['mode']==mode for r in m['domains'][domain]['nonempty'] if r['index']==index)
    def change(native,allocation,new_call=None,remove=False,swap=False):
        row=record(native,allocation)
        frames=[s for s in row['segments'] if s['kind']=='frame']
        selected=frames[allocation['frame_position']]
        parts=[s['raw'] for s in row['segments']]
        position=row['segments'].index(selected)
        if remove:
            parts.pop(position)
        elif swap:
            other=row['segments'].index(frames[allocation['frame_position']+1])
            parts[position],parts[other]=parts[other],parts[position]
        else:
            need(new_call is not None and selected['raw'].count(selected['call'])==1,'unique complete raw call mutation')
            parts[position]=selected['raw'].replace(selected['call'],new_call,1)
        body=''.join(parts)
        need(body!=row['body'],'genuine whole original body intervention')
        row.update(body=body,body_identity=pin(body.encode()),**trace(body))
    def trial(name,mutate,cause,prior=False):
        native,selected,source,actual=copy.deepcopy((original,selection,product,joined))
        mutate(native,selected,source,actual)
        need(not same([native,selected,source,actual],[original,selection,product,joined]),'genuine whole header control')
        previous=None
        if prior:
            previous=old['prior_predicates'](expected,native,nested)
            need(not same(previous,old['prior_predicates'](expected,original,nested)), 'actual predecessor receives the changed full header')
        # Rebuild the candidate product for raw interventions so this is a real
        # source/encoded-header test, rather than a stale checksum refusal.
        if not same(native,original):
            try:
                actual=join_headers.join(native,selected,source)
                oracle.validate(actual,native,selected,source)
            except ValueError as error:
                refusal=str(error)
            else:
                raise ValueError('accepted hostile complete raw header: '+name)
        else:
            try:
                oracle.validate(actual,native,selected,source)
            except ValueError as error:
                refusal=str(error)
            else:
                raise ValueError('accepted hostile complete header product: '+name)
        need(refusal==cause,'intended whole encoded-header control: '+name+': '+refusal)
        independent = None
        if not same(native,original):
            try:
                oracle.validate(actual,native,selected,source)
            except ValueError as error:
                independent = str(error)
            else:
                raise ValueError('independent reader accepted hostile raw header: '+name)
            need(independent==cause,'independent intended whole header control: '+name+': '+independent)
        candidate=canonical(dict(native=native,selection=selected,source=source,joined=actual))
        raw=gzip.compress(candidate,mtime=0)
        path=BASE/'controls'/('candidate-'+name+'.json.gz')
        if write:
            path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            if path.exists():
                need(path.read_bytes()==raw,'preserve identical whole first-attempt candidate')
            else:
                path.write_bytes(raw)
        else:
            need(path.read_bytes()==raw,'whole hostile header candidate/replay')
        results.append(dict(name=name,cause=refusal,status='rejected',candidate=str(path.relative_to(BASE)),identity=pin(raw),
                            independent_raw_refusal=independent,
                            limited_predecessor_actual_result=previous,
                            predecessor_meaning='Declared visible-prefix compatibility only; unchanged historical whole-reader custody still rejects mutations.'))
    # The exact diagnosed gap: a different proper prefix is admitted by the
    # limited predecessor and refused by the new whole known-token contract.
    long_public=next(a for a in selection['public_headers']
        if len(product['operands'][a['complete_argument_ids'][0]]['source']['qualification']['value'])>64
        and len(record(original,a)['body'].split('Test::Builder::subtest('))==2)
    original_call=[f for f in record(original,long_public)['segments'] if f['kind']=='frame'][long_public['frame_position']]['call']
    name=join_headers.tokens(product['operands'][long_public['complete_argument_ids'][0]],product)[0]
    shortened='"'+product['operands'][long_public['complete_argument_ids'][0]]['source']['qualification']['value'][0]+'"...'
    trial('different-proper-public-name-prefix',lambda n,s,p,j:change(n,long_public,original_call.replace(name,shortened,1)),
          'whole source-qualified literal argument header',prior=True)
    trial('lost-truncation-marker',lambda n,s,p,j:change(n,long_public,original_call.replace(name,name[:-3],1)),
          'whole source-qualified literal argument header')
    trial('wrong-quote-delimiter',lambda n,s,p,j:change(n,long_public,original_call.replace(name,"'borrowed'",1)),
          'whole source-qualified literal argument header')
    count=next(a for a in selection['source_headers'] if len(next(h for h in product['headers'] if h['id']==a['header_id'])['source_argument_ids'])>8)
    count_call=[f for f in record(original,count)['segments'] if f['kind']=='frame'][count['frame_position']]['call']
    trial('lost-argument-count-marker',lambda n,s,p,j:change(n,count,count_call.replace(', ...)',')',1)),
          'whole source-qualified argument-count marker')
    first=selection['source_headers'][0]
    # Choose the first core _require call; its following operation has a
    # distinct full function, so omission/reordering cannot hide in aliases.
    core=next(a for a in selection['source_headers'] if a['source_path'][-3:]==['own','core',0])
    core_call=[f for f in record(original,core)['segments'] if f['kind']=='frame'][core['frame_position']]['call']
    trial('borrowed-whole-header',lambda n,s,p,j:change(n,core,'main::__ANON__()'),'whole source-qualified call framing')
    trial('omitted-whole-frame',lambda n,s,p,j:change(n,core,remove=True),'whole source-qualified call framing')
    trial('reordered-whole-frames',lambda n,s,p,j:change(n,core,swap=True),'whole source-qualified call framing')
    reference=next(row for row in joined['source_headers'] if any(a.get('qualified_current_alternatives',[]) is None for a in row['joined']['arguments']))
    reference_argument=next(a for a in reference['joined']['arguments'] if a.get('qualified_current_alternatives',[]) is None)
    token=reference_argument['token'];prefix,address=token.rsplit('(0x',1);replacement=prefix+'(0x'+('1' if address[0]!='1' else '2')+address[1:]
    trial('changed-whole-opaque-reference',lambda n,s,p,j:change(n,reference['allocation'],reference['joined']['complete_call'].replace(token,replacement,1)),
          'every complete original raw/address/coordinate/source domain conserves')
    generic='whole independently reconstructed original header result'
    trial('omitted-source-header-result',lambda n,s,p,j:j['source_headers'].pop(),generic)
    trial('reordered-source-header-results',lambda n,s,p,j:j['source_headers'].reverse(),generic)
    trial('wrong-full-source-role',lambda n,s,p,j:j['source_headers'][0]['source_header']['source_metadata'].update(role='borrowed'),generic)
    trial('lost-complete-private-interval',lambda n,s,p,j:j['complete_opaque_allocation'][0]['whole_opaque_frames'].pop(),generic)
    trial('original-settings-promotion',lambda n,s,p,j:j['original_unknowns'].update(settings_formatter='measured'),generic)
    trial('wrong-whole-scope',lambda n,s,p,j:j.update(scope='Original native/provider/private observer acceptance closed.'),generic)
    trial('wrong-qualified-source-profile',lambda n,s,p,j:p['current_profile'].update(MaxArgLen=16),
          'whole committed complete source-header expression')
    return results


if __name__=='__main__':
    save('controls.json',controls(write=True))
    print('PASS genuine complete original raw/header/order/role/quote/truncation/count/source/scope controls and actual limited-predecessor distinction.')

"""Join whole encoded original calls to full source literals and opaque intervals."""
import re
from common import CLASS, HEADERS, SCOPE, canonical, load, need, pin, read, save


def tokens(binding, product):
    alternatives = []
    for identifier in binding['current_construction_cases']:
        row = product['current_construction_cases'][identifier]
        if row['kind'] != 'predicate' and row['case']['limit'] != 64:
            continue
        spelling = row['case']['display_token'] if row['kind'] == 'predicate' else row['case']['display']['token']
        if spelling not in alternatives:
            alternatives.append(spelling)
    return alternatives


def call(call_text, function, argument_ids, product, receiver=None):
    if function == 'eval {...}':
        need(not argument_ids and call_text == function, 'whole source-qualified eval marker')
        return dict(function=function, arguments=[], hidden_argument_ids=[], complete_call=call_text,
                    original_meaning='source eval boundary only; private implementation unmeasured')
    opening = function + '('
    need(call_text.startswith(opening) and call_text.endswith(')'), 'whole source-qualified call framing')
    cursor = len(opening)
    rows = []
    if receiver is not None:
        need(call_text[cursor:].startswith(receiver + ', '), 'whole opaque public receiver conservation')
        rows.append(dict(source_role='whole opaque public receiver', token=receiver,
                         interval_bytes=[len(call_text[:cursor].encode()), len(call_text[:cursor+len(receiver)].encode())],
                         original_meaning='contents/class/identity/private implementation unmeasured'))
        cursor += len(receiver) + 2
    visible = argument_ids[:8]
    for index, identifier in enumerate(visible):
        binding = product['operands'][identifier]
        source = binding['source']
        qualified = source['qualification']
        start = cursor
        if qualified['kind'] == 'source reference role and kind only':
            kind = qualified['reference_kind']
            display_class = source['input'].get('display_class')
            if display_class is not None:
                kind = display_class + '=' + kind
            match = re.match(re.escape(kind) + r'\(0x[0-9a-f]+\)', call_text[cursor:])
            need(match is not None, 'whole source-qualified reference kind/token syntax')
            token = match.group()
            alternatives = None
            meaning = 'Complete original encoded interval and source kind/role only; address/referent/receiver/native identity unmeasured.'
        else:
            alternatives = tokens(binding, product)
            matches = [value for value in alternatives if call_text.startswith(value, cursor)
                       and call_text[cursor+len(value):].startswith((', ', ')'))]
            need(len(matches) == 1, 'whole source-qualified literal argument header')
            token = matches[0]
            meaning = ('Complete known source value under an explicit qualifying current grammar; original flags/settings/encoding/provider remain unmeasured.'
                       if qualified['kind'] != 'qualified whole authored regex' else
                       'Complete authored regex value and full qualified constructor alternatives; matched original encoded spelling does not measure original flags/encoding/provider.')
        cursor += len(token)
        rows.append(dict(argument_id=identifier, source=source, token=token,
                         interval_bytes=[len(call_text[:start].encode()),len(call_text[:cursor].encode())],
                         qualified_current_alternatives=alternatives, original_meaning=meaning))
        if index+1 < len(visible):
            need(call_text[cursor:cursor+2] == ', ', 'whole source-qualified argument separator')
            cursor += 2
    if len(argument_ids) > 8:
        need(call_text[cursor:cursor+5] == ', ...', 'whole source-qualified argument-count marker')
        cursor += 5
    need(call_text[cursor:] == ')', 'whole source-qualified complete argument population')
    assembled = opening + ', '.join(([receiver] if receiver is not None else []) + [r['token'] for r in rows if 'argument_id' in r]
                    + (['...'] if len(argument_ids)>8 else [])) + ')'
    need(assembled == call_text, 'whole source-generated complete original call equality')
    return dict(function=function, arguments=rows, hidden_argument_ids=argument_ids[8:], complete_call=assembled,
                qualifying_profile=product['current_profile'],
                original_meaning='Finite encoded compatibility and complete opaque conservation only; original settings and native/private attribution unmeasured.')


def join(native, selection, product):
    records = {(m['mode'], domain, r['index']):r for m in native
               for domain, values in m['domains'].items() for r in values['nonempty']}
    header_table = {r['id']:r for r in product['headers']}
    previous = read(CLASS/'proofs.json')['full_prior_public_join']
    receivers = {(m['mode'],c['domain'],c['index'],p['phase']):p['public_header_compatibility']['receiver_opaque']
                 for m in previous['modes'] for c in m['cases'] for p in c['phases']}
    result = []
    covered = {}
    for allocation in selection['source_headers']:
        key = tuple(allocation['record'])
        record = records[key]
        frame = [r for r in record['segments'] if r['kind']=='frame'][allocation['frame_position']]
        header = header_table[allocation['header_id']]
        need(header['path'] == allocation['source_path'], 'whole source/header role allocation')
        joined = call(frame['call'], header['expression']['function'], header['source_argument_ids'], product)
        result.append(dict(allocation=allocation, source_header=header, original_frame=frame, joined=joined))
        covered.setdefault(key, set()).add(allocation['frame_position'])
    public = []
    for allocation in selection['public_headers']:
        key = tuple(allocation['record'])
        record = records[key]
        frame = [r for r in record['segments'] if r['kind']=='frame'][allocation['frame_position']]
        receiver = receivers[(*key, allocation['phase'])]
        joined = call(frame['call'], allocation['function'], allocation['complete_argument_ids'], product, receiver)
        public.append(dict(allocation=allocation, original_frame=frame, joined=joined))
        covered.setdefault(key, set()).add(allocation['frame_position'])
    loads = []
    for allocation in selection['loads']:
        key = tuple(allocation['record'])
        frame = [r for r in records[key]['segments'] if r['kind']=='frame'][allocation['frame_position']]
        need(frame['call'] == allocation['diagnostic_marker'] and allocation['source_operator']=='do'
             and allocation['diagnostic_marker_is_source_operator'] is False, 'whole source do/diagnostic require boundary')
        loads.append(dict(allocation=allocation, original_frame=frame))
        covered.setdefault(key, set()).add(allocation['frame_position'])
    remaining = []
    for key in sorted(covered):
        record = records[key]
        frames = [r for r in record['segments'] if r['kind']=='frame']
        remaining.append(dict(record=list(key), covered_frame_positions=sorted(covered[key]),
            whole_opaque_frames=[dict(frame_position=i, frame=frame) for i,frame in enumerate(frames) if i not in covered[key]],
            meaning='All remaining complete private/framework intervals conserved; no semantic/native/private attribution.'))
    return dict(scope=SCOPE, source_headers=result, public_headers=public, loads=loads,
                complete_opaque_allocation=remaining, original_unknowns=selection['original_unknowns'],
                full_original_raw_domain=pin(canonical(native)),
                source_first_selection=pin(canonical(selection)))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    native = read(CLASS/'raw-product.json')['inventories']
    selected = load('selected.json')
    product = read(HEADERS/'headers.json')
    joined = join(native, selected, product)
    save('original-raw-intake.json',dict(scope=SCOPE, original=pin((CLASS/'raw-product.json').read_bytes()),
        committed_source_selection=pin((HEADERS/'selection.json').read_bytes()),
        own_source_selection=pin((__import__('common').BASE/'selected.json').read_bytes()),
        meaning='First own encoded comparison uses complete prior canonical raw inventory; no original recapture.'))
    save('joined.json',joined)
    print('PASS complete original encoded source/public headers, full literals/count/grammar and whole opaque intervals; original native/private/settings identity remains unmeasured.')

"""Replay complete first import, receiver-decoder and count-diagnostic failures."""
import gzip
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, CLASS, HEADERS, canonical, load, need, pin, read, same
import join_headers
import oracle


def first_program(receipt,name):
    actual=load(receipt);source=actual['programs'][str(BASE/name)]
    need(source['identity']==pin(source['body'].encode()) and type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status']!=0,
         'complete retained failed programme epoch and actual result')
    namespace={'__name__':'original_header_first_decoder','__file__':str(BASE/name)}
    exec(compile(source['body'],str(BASE/name),'exec'),namespace)
    return namespace,source['identity']


def replay():
    scratch=Path('.artifacts/observer-original-header-join-20261011/relocated-import')
    scratch.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    sources={str(BASE/'first-selection-source.py.txt'):(BASE/'first-selection-source.py.txt').read_bytes(),
             str(BASE/'common.py'):(BASE/'common.py').read_bytes()}
